system_prompt: You are a bank's digital assistant on a phone call. Speak English.

talk_open.name: talk_open

on_enter.text: Hello, this is the automated assistant of Corrib Valley Bank. We record this call. May I speak with {{first_name}} {{last_name}}?

talk_open.task_message:
Repeat exactly this sentence and nothing else: {{say}}
Do not call a tool in this turn.

extraction_schema.name: open_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify ONLY the customer's latest message. Values: confirmed = the person confirms they are the customer: yes, that's me, speaking, or says the customer's own name; third_party = someone else answered (a relative, partner, colleague, child) or says the customer is not available; wrong_number = says this number does not belong to the customer or they do not know the customer at all (a 'no' because someone else answered, e.g. a relative, is third_party); deceased = says the customer has died / passed away; robot = asks whether you are a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks whether this call is a scam or fraud, or doubts that you are the bank; purpose = asks what the call is about or who is calling, without confirming; human = asks to speak to a real person / a human agent; not_talk = says they do not want to talk / are not interested / asks you to stop; unclear = anything else: hello, go ahead, who is this, unclear or no answer; none = nothing new was said.

extraction_schema.name: open_cut
extraction_schema.description: yes = the customer's latest message stops in the middle of a sentence, ending on an unfinished phrase (e.g. '... I would like', '... I want to', '... sorry, I mean', '... on the'), so they have not finished; no = it is a complete thought.

extraction_schema.name: open_side
extraction_schema.description: Does the customer's latest message ALSO contain a side question, besides its main point? robot = asks if you are a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks if this is a scam or doubts you are the bank; question = asks another question you should answer; none = no side question.

extraction_schema.name: tp_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify ONLY the customer's latest message. Values: gives_time = gives a day and/or time when the customer can be reached; no_time = does not know when the customer can be reached, or will not say; customer_now = says the customer is coming to the phone or hands the phone over; wrong_number = says the number does not belong to the customer / does not know them; deceased = says the customer has died / passed away; purpose = asks what the call is about; offers_pay = offers to pay or to answer questions for the customer; robot = asks whether you are a robot or an AI; scam = asks whether this is a scam; unclear = anything else; none = nothing new was said.

extraction_schema.name: tp_cut

extraction_schema.name: tp_side

extraction_schema.name: tp_text

extraction_schema.name: id_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify ONLY the customer's latest message. Values: answer = gives an answer to the security question (any date, number, digits or words), even partial; refuses = refuses or does not want to answer the security question; asks_why = asks why you need this information or why you ask, without answering; purpose = asks what the call is about or which account it concerns, without answering; robot = asks whether you are a robot or an AI; scam = asks whether this is a scam; human = asks to speak to a human; not_talk = says they do not want to talk; wrong_person = says they are not the customer after all; unclear = anything else; none = nothing new was said.

extraction_schema.name: id_cut
extraction_schema.description: yes = the customer's latest message stops in the middle of a sentence, ending on an unfinished phrase (e.g. '... I would like', '... I want to', '... sorry, I mean', '... on the'), so they have not finished; no = it is a complete thought.

extraction_schema.name: id_side
extraction_schema.description: Does the customer's latest message ALSO contain a side question, besides its main point? robot = asks if you are a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks if this is a scam or doubts you are the bank; question = asks another question you should answer; none = no side question.

extraction_schema.name: id_text
extraction_schema.description: The customer's answer to the security question in their latest message, copied exactly as said (keep every digit and word, e.g. 'the fourteenth of March 1988' or 'four four seven one'). Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: id_norm
extraction_schema.description: The same answer normalised: a date as YYYY-MM-DD (day before month when only numbers are said), a number or code as its digits or characters only, without spaces. Empty if no answer.

Do not call a tool in this turn.

extraction_schema.name: nego_kind
extraction_schema.description: Classify ONLY the customer's latest message. Values: yes = agrees / accepts what was just offered or asked (yes, ok, fine, that works, I confirm); no = says no / cannot / will not, without giving a date or an amount; proposes = names a day, a date or an amount they can pay (the date of an unrelated event, e.g. a wedding or a trip, is not a proposal: use unclear); too_much = "That is too much": the next proposal is the floor.; vague = gives a vague time like next week, end of the month, when my salary comes, without an exact day; already_paid = The customer says the product is already paid.; dispute = The customer disputes the debt.; hardship = Financial hardship (job loss, illness, bereavement). (small talk about being busy, tired, stressed or having a lot of work is NOT this: use unclear); restructure = Asks for a repayment plan or lower instalments.; human = Asks for a person.; robot = asks whether you are a robot or an AI; scam = asks whether this is a scam; not_talk = says they do not want to talk about this; asks_amount = asks how much they should or can pay, what the options are, or says 'you tell me', without refusing in the same message; details = asks which account or product this is, how much they owe, how late it is, or asks you to repeat the amount; question = asks another question; unclear = anything else; none = nothing new was said.

extraction_schema.name: nego_cut
extraction_schema.description: yes = the customer's latest message stops in the middle of a sentence, ending on an unfinished phrase (e.g. '... I would like', '... I want to', '... sorry, I mean', '... on the'), so they have not finished; no = it is a complete thought.

extraction_schema.name: nego_side
extraction_schema.description: Does the customer's latest message ALSO contain a side question, besides its main point? robot = asks if you are a robot, a machine or an AI; scam = asks if this is a scam or doubts you are the bank; question = asks another question you should answer; none = no side question.

extraction_schema.name: nego_text
extraction_schema.description: The customer's latest message, copied exactly as written, including how it ends.

extraction_schema.name: nego_date
extraction_schema.description: The day or date the customer OFFERS TO PAY on in the latest message (not dates of other events), copied exactly as said (e.g. 'this Friday', 'next Tuesday', 'the 23rd', '30 October', 'next week'). If they correct themselves, only the corrected value. Empty if no day is mentioned.

extraction_schema.name: nego_amount
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer offers or agrees to pay in the latest message, as a number (e.g. 'six hundred thirty-seven fifty' = 637.5). If they correct themselves, the corrected value. Empty if none.

extraction_schema.name: nego_for
extraction_schema.description: Which product the customer's date, amount or yes/no in the latest message is about. card = the credit card; loan = the personal loan; overdraft = the overdraft; all = all of their products together (both, all three, everything); none = not stated. If they accept one product and refuse the others, give the product they accept.
